occurred-at:call-to-macedonia>troas_1182.note: The vision comes after they reached Troas and before they sailed from there. The place of the vision is implied, not stated.

occurred-at:lydia-s-conversion>philippi_.note: Lydia heard them at a riverside prayer place outside the city (16:13), in Philippi (16:12). Near Philippi; 'at Philippi' is a reading.

occurred-at:mission-to-phrygia-galatia-a.note: The text says they were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia. They went through Phrygia and Galatia instead.

occurred-at:paul-and-silas-imprisoned>ph.note: The scene is in the city where they were abiding (16:12); the accusers say 'our city' (16:20). Philippi is not named in 16:19-24.

occurred-at:paul-and-silas-released>phil.note: The magistrates bring them out and ask them to leave the city (16:39). Philippi is not named in 16:35-40.

occurred-at:paul-casts-demon-out-of-soot.note: The scene falls in their stay at Philippi (16:12). The city is not named in 16:16-18.

occurred-at:philippian-jailer-converted>.note: The jailer's prison is in the city where they were staying (16:12). The city is not named in 16:25-34.

occurred-at:timothy-joins-paul-and-silas.note: They came to Derbe and Lystra and the disciple was 'there'; the text does not say which. Reputation at Lystra (16:2) points to Lystra.

parent-of:eunice_1228>timotheus_2863@a16.note: 2 Timothy 1:5 names Eunice as Timothy's mother. Acts 16:1 says his mother was a Jewess, which fits.

part-of:neapolis_880>macedonia_747@950da.note: They sail to Neapolis and go from there to Philippi, 'that part of Macedonia' (16:12). Neapolis in Macedonia is inferred, not stated.

part-of:philippi_942>macedonia_747@68f68.note: Philippi is 'the chief city of that part of Macedonia' (16:12).

participated-in:lydia_1837>second-missio.note: Lydia acts only in the Philippi stop of the journey (16:14-15, 40). The journey as a whole is not hers; the event name is outside the text.

participated-in:paul_2479>mission-to-phr.note: 'They' in 16:6 is Paul's company, which Paul leads (16:3-4). The travel through Phrygia and Galatia is theirs.

participated-in:silas_2740>mission-to-ph.note: Paul chose Silas to go with him (15:40). 'They' went through the cities (16:4) and through Phrygia and Galatia (16:6). Silas is inferred within 'they'.

participated-in:silas_2740>paul-and-sila.note: 'Those men' and 'you' are let go (16:35-36). 'They' went out of the prison (16:40), and Silas is with Paul there (16:19, 16:25).

participated-in:silas_2740>paul-casts-de.note: Silas is not named in 16:16-18. The masters seize Paul and Silas right after the exorcism (16:19), which implies he was there.

participated-in:timotheus_2863>mission-t.note: Timothy goes forth with Paul (16:3). 'They' went through the cities (16:4) and through Phrygia and Galatia (16:6).

participated-in:timotheus_2863>second-mi.note: Timothy joins Paul and goes forth with him (16:3). The journey's name is outside the text, so this is a reading.
